title: Ubukuru butagira aho bugarukira
intro: Mu bihugu vya kera vyose, hari ubukuru bukomeye bwahora bufise ububasha, bugategeka ubutunzi bwinshi cane be n’ubuzima bw’abantu batagira uko banganye. Naho uwo mutware yari afise ibimenyetso bitomoye be n’imburi, yahisemwo inzira yo gutera umugongo, ivyo bikaba vyatumye haba uguhangana gukomeye kwari gusubiramwo mu gihe cose.
clues: Narivugiye ko mfise ububasha n’ubukuru vy’agahebuzo ku karere kanini cane.
Narateye akagere intumwa yicishije bugufi yarungitswe n’Umukama w’ibibanza vyose.
Abantu banje bari bazwi cane kubera ubuhinga bwabo bwo kwubaka ibibanza bininibinini be n’uruzi rwari rufasha ubutekerezi bwacu.
Narabonye ibimenyetso vyinshi vy’igitangaza, harimwo n’inkoni yahindutse inzoka be n’ukuboko kwaka cane.
Naranse kureka umugwi w’abantu bari mu buja ngo bave mu gihugu canje, naho nari ntegetswe n’Imana.
Ugukurikirana kwanje abantu bariko baragenda kwatumye jewe n’ingabo zanje tuja mu mutima w’ikiyaga cagabanijwemwo ibice.

location.label: Gusobanura umuce
options: Intebe y'ubwami y'agaciro iri ku mazi .

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
